lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A highly regular grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular blobs, organized into approximately five horizontal rows and twelve vertical columns posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of diffuse light intensity serve as the primary axes for the arrangement of the blobs, with the circular high-luminance clusters positioned as nodes at the intersections of these vertical bands and horizontal rows.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with light-toned upper surfaces and shadowed lower edges.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, localized dark pigmentation anomaly or lesion is visible on the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the pectoral fin attachment point.
other_distinctive_markers: A small, high-luminance biotic entity (remora) is visible swimming in close proximity to the ventral side of the pectoral fin.
